title: Example Clips
about: Copy this file to channels/<your-channel>.json. One file per YouTube channel you run.
rightsNote: Say where your right to clip comes from, e.g. 'Creator's clip program, joined 2026-09-01' or 'our own videos'.
niche: What this channel is about and who it is for. The agent reads this to pick moments.
lookFor: a strong opinion said in one breath
a funny exchange with a clear punchline
a practical tip someone could use today
